title: Taking, Asking, Helping, Liking
label: ch:pt-taking-asking-helping-liking
canDo: I can say that I take, ask, help and like in Portuguese, choose between its two verbs for taking, and keep de attached to gostar.

payoff.summary: The chapter's last lesson closes the set: after gostar de the reader produces the eight first-person forms of both verb chapters in one run - penso, entendo, leio, escrevo, pego, pergunto, ajudo, gosto - explains why the de cannot be dropped, and ties gostar back to saber as the second Portuguese verb that stopped meaning to taste.
